main_text.p: תְּלֻנּוֹת murmurationes, No. pl. f. Rad. לון per-noctare.
תִּלְחַם pugnabis, vel bit, תִּלְחֲמוּ[?] comprimes, vel met, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. לחם & לחץ.
תָּלִין pernoctabis, vel bit, תָּלִינוּ pernoctabitis, (pro תָּלִינוּ,) fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. לון.
תִּלָּכֵד capieris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. לכד.
תִּלְכּוּ ibitis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. ילך.
תִּלֵּכְנָה ibunt, ibitis, pro תִּלֵּכְנָה, fut. Kal, 3. vel 2. pl. f. Rad. ילך.
תַּלְמִיד discipulus, No. f. m. Rad. למד didicit.
תָּלֵן pernoctato, Job. 17. 2. pro תָּלִין, fut. Hiph. 3. f. f. vel 3. f. m. Rad. לון.
comp. ex Rad. תָּלָה suspendit, & פִּיּוֹת acies, pl. f. No. Rad. פֶּה os oris.
תַּלְהֲלִים crispaturæ, No. pl. m. Rad. תָּלַל accumulare.
main_text.head: ת מ
main_text.p: תָּם integer, תֹּם integritas, No. f. m. כְּתָם juxta absolvi, Inf. Kal, præf. Rad. תמם perfici.
תַּם absumptus est, præt. Kal, 3. sing. m. Rad. תַּמַּם.
תְּמָאֵן renues, vel et, תְּמָאֲנוּ renuetis, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. מָאַן.
תְּמַאֵם spernes, vel net, תְּמַאֵם spretaes, vel est, fut. Kal, & Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מָאַם.
תָּמֹג liquefiet, pro תָּמוֹג, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. Rad. מוּג. תִּמְנָגְךָ[?]

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters in the small print are hard to read at this scan resolution; the Hebrew forms marked [?] are doubtful. The entry "תִּלְחַם / תִּלְחִין" and the final Hebrew word "תִּמְנָגְךָ" are the least certain. The Latin entry "vox" at the foot of the left column continues in the right column as "comp. ex", and is kept as printed. Printed hyphen in "per-noctare" is retained. No catchword, signature or marginal notes are visible. The Google "Digitized by" banner is omitted.
